title: Schema validity is not invoice correctness
method: Synthetic fixed corpus of 200 invoices. Count schema-valid responses and separately count fully correct records against reference annotations; percentages divide by 200. Measures overlap. Illustrates validation layers, not measured model performance.
alt: Schema validity is not invoice correctness. Prompt: schema valid: 190 invoices, Constrained: valid: 198 invoices, Prompt: correct: 174 invoices, Constrained: correct: 180 invoices. Illustrative data.
